# Game Idea

**Asteroid Dodge** – A top‑down endless runner where the player pilots a small spaceship using the mouse or arrow keys. Asteroids scroll down the canvas at increasing speed. The player must weave between gaps and can collect occasional fuel pickups to boost speed and score. **Lose condition:** The game ends instantly when the ship collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.

1: // Enhanced Asteroid Dodge game with richer graphics and sound effects
2: (() => {
3:   // Audio setup
4:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
5:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
6:   // Ensure audio context is running after user interaction
7:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { audioCtx.resume(); }, {once: true});
8:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
22:   if (!canvas) return;
23:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
24:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
25:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
26: 
27:   // ----- Starfield background -----
28:   const stars = [];
29:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
30:     stars.push({
31:       x: Math.random() * width,
32:       y: Math.random() * height,
33:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
34:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
35:     });
36:   }
37:   function drawStars() {
38:     ctx.save();
39:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
40:     stars.forEach(s => {
41:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
42:       ctx.beginPath();
43:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
44:       ctx.fill();
45:     });
46:     ctx.restore();
47:   }
48: 
49:   // ----- Ship -----
50:   const ship = {
51:     x: width / 2,
52:     y: height - 40,
53:     w: 30,
54:     h: 40,
55:     fuel: 100
56:   };
57:   // Input handling
58:   let mouseX = ship.x;
59:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
60:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
61:     mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
62:   });
63:   const keys = {};
64:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
65:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
66: 
67:   // ----- Asteroids & fuel pickups -----
68:   const asteroids = [];
69:   const fuels = [];
70:   let frame = 0;
71:   let score = 0;
72:   let gameOver = false;
73: 
74:   function spawnAsteroid() {
75:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
76:     asteroids.push({
77:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
78:       y: -size,
79:       size,
80:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
81:       angle: 0,
82:       spin: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04 // radians per frame
83:     });
84:   }
85: 
86:   function spawnFuel() {
87:     const size = 12;
88:     fuels.push({
89:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
90:       y: -size,
91:       size,
92:       speed: 2
93:     });
94:   }
95: 
96:   function update(dt) {
97:     // Ship movement (keyboard & smooth mouse follow)
98:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= 200 * dt;
99:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += 200 * dt;
100:     ship.x += (mouseX - ship.x) * 0.1;
101:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
102: 
103:     // Fuel consumption
104:     ship.fuel -= dt * 5;
105:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
106: 
107:     // Spawn logic
108:     if (frame % 60 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
109:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnFuel();
110: 
111:     // Update positions
112:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
113:       a.y += a.speed;
114:       a.angle += a.spin;
115:     });
116:     fuels.forEach(f => (f.y += f.speed));
117: 
118:     // Remove off‑screen objects
119:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y > height) asteroids.shift();
120:     while (fuels.length && fuels[0].y > height) fuels.shift();
121: 
122:     // Collision detection
123:     for (const a of asteroids) {
124:       if (
125:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w &&
126:         a.x + a.size > ship.x &&
127:         a.y < ship.y + ship.h &&
128:         a.y + a.size > ship.y
129:       ) {
130:         gameOver = true;
131:         // Play collision sound
132:         playTone(150, 0.3);
133:         break;
134:       }
135:     }
136:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
137:       const f = fuels[i];
138:       if (
139:         f.x < ship.x + ship.w &&
140:         f.x + f.size > ship.x &&
141:         f.y < ship.y + ship.h &&
142:         f.y + f.size > ship.y
143:       ) {
144:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
145:         // Play fuel pickup sound
146:         playTone(600, 0.15);
147:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
148:       }
149:     }
150: 
151:     score += dt * 10;
152:     frame++;
153:   }
154: 
155:   function drawShip() {
156:     ctx.save();
157:     // Gradient for ship hull
158:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
159:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
160:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
161:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
162:     // Draw as a simple triangle
163:     ctx.beginPath();
164:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
165:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
166:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
167:     ctx.closePath();
168:     ctx.fill();
169:     ctx.restore();
170:   }
171: 
172:   function drawAsteroids() {
173:     ctx.save();
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
175:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
176:       ctx.translate(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2);
177:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
178:       ctx.beginPath();
179:       // Rough polygon to simulate rock
180:       const steps = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
181:       for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
182:         const theta = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
183:         const radius = a.size / 2 * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
184:         const px = Math.cos(theta) * radius;
185:         const py = Math.sin(theta) * radius;
186:         if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
187:         else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
188:       }
189:       ctx.closePath();
190:       ctx.fill();
191:       ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); // reset transform
192:     });
193:     ctx.restore();
194:   }
195: 
196:   function drawFuel() {
197:     ctx.save();
198:     fuels.forEach(f => {
199:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
200:         f.x + f.size / 2,
201:         f.y + f.size / 2,
202:         0,
203:         f.x + f.size / 2,
204:         f.y + f.size / 2,
205:         f.size / 2
206:       );
207:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
208:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c90');
209:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
210:       ctx.beginPath();
211:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.size / 2, f.y + f.size / 2, f.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
212:       ctx.fill();
213:     });
214:     ctx.restore();
215:   }
216: 
217:   function draw() {
218:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
219:     drawStars();
220:     drawShip();
221:     drawAsteroids();
222:     drawFuel();
223:     // UI overlay
224:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
225:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
226:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
227:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.ceil(ship.fuel), 10, 20);
228:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 40);
229:     if (gameOver) {
230:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
231:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
232:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
233:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
234:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
235:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
236:     }
237:   }
238: 
239:   let last = performance.now();
240:   function loop(now) {
241:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
242:     last = now;
243:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
244:     draw();
245:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
246:   }
247:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
248: })();
249:
